ctx.x: You know, for, he don't like for people to put pressure on him uhm, so he figured that's what Son Stitt was doing to him you know, because all the people was applaud man, they went crazy, you know, so Dizzy brought the rhythm section down, volume-wise, and he start fiddling man, he got, he fiddled all through the horn and all the changes, I say oh, for I say about a good seven-eight choruses.
